common.error: ⚠️ Internal error. Please try again later.
common.busy: ⌛ This request is already being processed.

start.greeting: 👋 Telegram News Aggregator Pick a channel — I will show its latest posts and store them.

help.text: ℹ️ How to use /start — channel list /language — interface language /premium — plans /subscription — subscription status /trial — free trial /help — this message The «🔄 Refresh» button in the post list pulls fresh posts from the channel.

channels.unknown: This channel is no longer supported.
channels.cooldown: ⏳ You can refresh this channel in {seconds}.

post.media_failed: ⚠️ Media is unavailable, showing text only.

billing.plans_header: ⭐ Subscription Payment goes through Telegram Stars — no cards, no external providers. Pick a plan:
billing.no_subscription: 💳 No active subscription Subscribe to use the aggregator without limits.
billing.info: 💳 Your subscription Plan: {plan} Status: {status} Valid until: {expires} Remaining: {left}
billing.invoice_failed: ❌ Could not create the invoice. Please try again later.
billing.already_applied: ℹ️ This payment has already been processed.
billing.paid: ✅ Payment received, thank you! Plan: {plan} Subscription is active until: {expires}
billing.not_activated: ⚠️ The payment went through, but the subscription could not be activated. Please send this transaction code to support: {charge_id}

errors.plan_not_found: This plan is no longer available.
errors.payment_not_found: The invoice was not found or has expired.
errors.payment_mismatch: Payment details do not match the invoice.
errors.too_many_pending: Too many unpaid invoices. Complete or cancel the previous one.

precheckout.not_found: Invoice not found. Please create a new one.
precheckout.foreign: This invoice belongs to another user.
precheckout.already_paid: This invoice has already been paid.
precheckout.invalid: This invoice is no longer valid.
precheckout.currency_mismatch: Payment currency does not match the invoice.
precheckout.amount_mismatch: Payment amount does not match the invoice.

billing.method_header: How would you like to pay for {title}?
billing.crypto_invoice: 💎 {title} Amount due: {amount} {asset} The invoice is valid for {ttl}. The subscription starts automatically once the transfer is confirmed.
billing.crypto_unavailable: ❌ Crypto payment is temporarily unavailable. Try later or pay with Stars.

trial.offer: 🎁 Free trial for {days} Full access to every channel and feature — free, with no charges. To rule out repeated activation from several accounts, a phone number is required. Tap the button below — Telegram sends it for you. The number is not stored: only an irreversible fingerprint goes into the database. Changed your mind — send /cancel.
trial.need_button:
📱 A number from Telegram is required — text typed by hand cannot be verified.

Tap «Share phone number» or send /cancel.
trial.cancelled: Alright, the trial was not activated.
trial.cancel_hint: You can subscribe at any time.
trial.declined_hint: Access is available with a subscription.
trial.activated: 🎁 Free trial for {days} Plan: {plan} Valid until: {expires} I will remind you a day before it ends.

errors.already_claimed: The trial has already been activated — it is granted once.
errors.subscription_active: You already have an active subscription — the trial is not needed.
errors.contact_required: Confirm your phone number to activate the trial.
errors.foreign_contact: This is someone else's contact. Tap «Share phone number» — forwarding a number from your address book will not work.
errors.fingerprint_phone: This phone number has already been used for a trial.
errors.fingerprint_ip: This address has already been used for a trial.
errors.fingerprint_device: This device has already been used for a trial.
errors.fingerprint_other: This identifier has already been used for a trial.

reasons.used: The trial has already been activated.
reasons.has_subscription: You already have an active subscription.

language.need_button: Pick a language with the buttons below or send /cancel.
language.cancelled: The interface language was left unchanged.

throttle.muted: 🚫 Too many requests. The bot will stay silent for {seconds}.
throttle.flood: ⏳ Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

worker.expiry_notice: ⏳ Your subscription ends soon Plan: {plan} Valid until: {expires} Extend it so you do not lose access.
worker.expired: 🔒 Subscription ended Plan {plan} expired on {expires}. Subscribe again to restore access.

sources.title: 📥 My sources This is where I take news from.
sources.empty: 📥 My sources None yet. Add the first one — send a channel link.
sources.prompt: Send a channel link or its name: @channel, t.me/channel or just channel. Cancel — /cancel.
sources.limit: Limit reached: {limit}. Disconnect one channel to add another.
sources.invalid: ❌ That does not look like a Telegram channel. Expected 5–32 characters: latin letters, digits and underscore.
sources.unavailable: ❌ Channel @{channel} is unavailable: it is private, missing or has no web preview.
sources.network: ❌ Could not reach Telegram. Try again in a minute.

targets.title: 📤 Auto-posting channels This is where I publish selected news.
targets.empty: 📤 Auto-posting channels None yet. Add a channel where the bot is an administrator.
targets.prompt: Make the bot an administrator with posting rights, then send the channel name @channel or forward any message from it here. Cancel — /cancel.
targets.limit: Limit reached: {limit}. Disconnect one channel to add another.
targets.not_found: ❌ Channel not found. Check the name or forward a message from it.
targets.not_admin: ❌ The bot is not an administrator of {channel}. Add it and try again.
targets.cannot_post: ❌ The bot cannot post in {channel}. Enable that right in the administrator settings.
targets.not_a_channel: ❌ This is not a channel. Auto-posting works with channels only.

keywords.title: 🔤 Word filter Triggers let a post through, stop words drop it.
keywords.prompt_triggers: Send trigger words separated by commas. Example: python, machine learning, release Cancel — /cancel.
keywords.prompt_stop: Send stop words separated by commas. Example: ads, giveaway Cancel — /cancel.
keywords.nothing_added: ℹ️ Every word you sent is already in the filter.
keywords.empty_input: ❌ I see no words. Send them separated by commas.
keywords.too_long: ❌ A word is longer than {limit} characters: {word}
keywords.limit: Limit reached: {limit} words. Clear the list to add new ones.

subscription.none: 💳 No active subscription Subscribe or activate the free trial.

search.prompt: 🔎 Archive search Send a query. Morphology works: «releases» finds «release». Exact phrase — in quotes: "machine learning" Exclude a word — with a minus: release -ads Cancel — /cancel.
search.nothing: 🔎 Nothing found for {query}. Try different words.
search.expired: The search has expired, start again: /search
search.locked: 🔒 Archive search Available with a subscription. Subscribe or activate the free trial.

errors.too_short: ❌ The query is too short — at least 2 characters.
errors.too_long: ❌ The query is too long — 128 characters at most.
